create_quantization_recipe: create a QuantizationModifier recipe to quantize Linear layers to FP8_DYNAMIC with per-channel weights
apply_oneshot_quantization: apply oneshot quantization to a pretrained transformer model using a QuantizationModifier recipe
test_reranker_model: test a quantized reranker model by scoring query-document pairs and extracting relevance scores from logits
dispatch_model_offload: dispatch a quantized model for inference using compressed_tensors offload
save_quantized_model: save a quantized model and tokenizer to disk in compressed-tensors format
